request_text: Fix #2339: the compat-planner.json JSON contract's migration_id pattern (^[a-z0-9_]{1,128}$) rejects the dominant dotted migration-id convention (83 of 89 migrations, e.g. '3.2.0rc45_retire_standalone_skill_surface'). Widen the pattern to ^[a-z0-9_.]{1,128}$ per the HiC decision posted on the issue. Fold into PR #2414's landing worktree.
